proposal.summary: The report describes a UI/layout bug where the 'Apply coupon' button overlaps the order total on the checkout page in Firefox 128 when the window width is under 600px.

A.quote: Bug: on the checkout page in Firefox 128, the 'Apply coupon' button overlaps the order total when the window is narrower than 600px.

proposal.recommended_next_step: No security action needed. Forward to the UI/layout/frontend team with reproduction steps and browser/version details so they can adjust responsive CSS to wrap the button under the total for widths <600px.

evidence_quotes.claim: Describes the bug and where it occurs
evidence_quotes.quote: Bug: on the checkout page in Firefox 128, the 'Apply coupon' button overlaps the order total when the window is narrower than 600px.
Steps: open cart, resize window, look at the right column.

evidence_quotes.claim: Expected behavior / not a security issue
evidence_quotes.quote: Expected: button wraps below the total. Not a security issue, just layout.
